title: Matcha and Cheese Naan
description: A twist on traditional naan, infused with the brightness of matcha and the creaminess of cheese. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together matcha powder and warm milk to create a paste.
2. Add yeast to the paste and let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
3. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast mixture, and salt. Mix until a dough forms.
4. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
5. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
7. Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
8. Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on the grill.
9. Cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until the naan is golden brown and crispy.
10. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with grated cheese.
11. Drizzle with honey and serve warm.
